fusions.name: Wringing Twist
fusions.desc: Wrings the target out for 9 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Sodden Shroud
fusions.desc: Throws a soaked sheet over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage, stunning everything under it for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Compress
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Padded Swaddling
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
